sentences.en: The swimmer raised his head and gasped for breath.
"No, no, Jack, for God's sake!" she gasped, in uncontrollable emotion.
sentences.zh: ‘不，杰克，求你了！’她因无法控制的情绪而喘息道。

sentences.en: I gasped with surprise at the horrible picture of the starving people.
sentences.zh: 我看到那张描绘饥荒中的人们的可怕图片时惊讶得倒抽了一口气。

senses.zh: 气喘吁吁地说；喘着气说话
